overall.summary: HLIO shows a pattern of reducing specificity in its temporal disclosures — removing restructuring cost figures, insurance proceeds details, intangible asset amortization specifics, and Pillar Two tax impact assessments between Q1 and Q2 2025 filings. While some removals have plausible explanations (e.g., fully amortized assets), the cumulative pattern of stripping quantitative detail from operational and financial discussions warrants monitoring. Notably, HLIO's geopolitical and tariff disclosures remain strong relative to peers, suggesting selective rather than systematic disclosure degradation.
